about.id: Mengawali ketertarikan pemrograman sejak bangku SMP, saya menempuh pendidikan di SMK Pertiwi Kuningan (Rekayasa Perangkat Lunak) dan melanjutkan studi D3 Manajemen Informatika di STMIK IKMI Cirebon. Fokus keahlian saya berakar pada Front-End UI Engineering presisi tinggi menggunakan React.js, TypeScript, dan Tailwind CSS, serta Full-Stack development berbasis Laravel. Selama magang di Disdukcapil Kab. Cirebon, saya mengembangkan dan mengoptimalkan antarmuka portal publik SINTREN dan KATON SINTREN dengan mengintegrasikan identitas lokal motif batik Mega Mendung.
about.en: My passion for coding started back in junior high school, leading me through vocational studies in Software Engineering at SMK Pertiwi Kuningan and currently pursuing an Associate Degree (D3) in Informatics Management at STMIK IKMI Cirebon. I specialize in high-precision Front-End UI engineering with React.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, coupled with robust full-stack architecture using Laravel. During my internship at Disdukcapil Cirebon Regency, I engineered and refined citizen portal interfaces for SINTREN and KATON SINTREN, infusing modern UI with regional Mega Mendung batik motifs.
